# 2 Baruch Chapter 7 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**1** I, Baruch, was there with Jeremiah when the city was handed over to the enemy.

**2** Jeremiah the prophet was permitted to go with the captives to Babylon. But I, Baruch, stayed behind.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. The stark contrast — Jeremiah goes, Baruch stays — is the hinge of the whole book. "Stayed behind" for "remained there" conveys the isolation and purpose. "Permitted" for "given leave" is more natural.*
